description: This file defines the 'testcase' class for managing test cases within the TestLink test management system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and displaying test cases, as well as handling related entities such as steps, keywords, test plans, and versions. It also references external files for managing requirements, assignments, attachments, users, and events.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Represents a test case in TestLink, providing methods to manage its lifecycle, retrieve information, and interact with related entities such as versions, steps, keywords, and test plans.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test case object with database connection, managers, configurations, and other properties.

methods.name: setTestProject
methods.description: Sets the current test project ID for this test case instance.

methods.name: getExecutionTypes
methods.description: Returns the array of execution types, including default and custom types.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the test case given its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test case with specified parameters, including name, summary, steps, keywords, and versioning info.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing test case and its version with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test case and all its related versions, steps, and related data.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays detailed information of a test case in the given template, including versions, steps, keywords, and related test plans.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves test cases matching a given name, optionally filtered by test suite and project.

methods.name: get_DuplicatesByName
methods.description: Finds duplicate test cases by name within a parent node, with optional filtering options.

methods.name: get_linked_versions
methods.description: Returns information about test case versions linked to test plans with optional filters.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves test case data, possibly in various formats, based on different filters and options.

methods.name: create_new_version
methods.description: Creates a new version of a test case, copying data and related entities from a source version or latest version.

methods.name: create_tcase_only
methods.description: Creates only the base test case node without versions or steps.

methods.name: get_last_version_info
methods.description: Returns info about the latest or minimum version of a test case, including optional steps.

methods.name: copy_tcversion
methods.description: Copies a test case version, including steps and custom fields, to a new version ID.

methods.name: copy_to
methods.description: Copies a complete test case, including versions, steps, keywords, and attachments, optionally to another project.

methods.name: get_by_id_bulk
methods.description: Retrieves multiple test cases or versions efficiently based on arrays of IDs.

methods.name: filterByKeyword
methods.description: Filters test cases based on keywords, supporting multiple keyword filters with logical OR/AND.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves keywords linked to a specific test case version, with options for output format and ordering.

methods.name: getKeywordsByIdCard
methods.description: Retrieves keywords associated with a specific identified card containing test case ID and version.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Returns a map of keywords for a given test case ID and version, with flexible output formats.

methods.name: addKeywords
methods.description: Adds new keywords to a test case version, optionally auditing.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Replaces existing keywords of a test case version with a new set.

methods.name: copyKeywordsTo
methods.description: Copies keywords from one test case version to another, handling ID mappings and auditing.

methods.name: deleteKeywords
methods.description: Removes specified keywords from a test case version, with optional auditing.

methods.name: deleteKeywordsByLink
methods.description: Deletes keyword links by link ID for a specific test case.

methods.name: getKeywordsAllTCVersions
methods.description: Retrieves all keywords associated across all versions of a test case.

methods.name: get_executions
methods.description: Retrieves execution data for a test case version, including steps, status, and responsible users.

methods.name: getInternalID
methods.description: Maps an external test case ID string to internal database ID(s), validating prefixes and external IDs.

methods.name: formatTestCaseIdentity
methods.description: Generates a formatted identity string for a test case based on its ID and external ID, including project prefix.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the test case prefix and project ID for a given test case ID.

methods.name: copy_to
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive copy of a test case, including versions, steps, keywords, and attachments, to a target node or project.

methods.name: create_new_version
methods.description: Creates a new version of a test case, optionally from a specific source version, copying all associated data.

methods.name: get_last_version_info
methods.description: Provides info about the most recent or minimum version of a test case, including optional steps.

methods.name: copy_tcversion
methods.description: Duplicates a test case version, including steps and custom fields, under a new ID.

methods.name: get_by_id_bulk
methods.description: Efficiently retrieves multiple test cases or versions based on ID arrays.

methods.name: filterByKeyword
methods.description: Filters test cases by associated keywords.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Fetches keywords for a test case version.

methods.name: updateTPlanLinkTCV
methods.description: Updates the link of a test case version within a test plan, synchronizing related execution entries and possibly defaulting to the latest version.

methods.name: saveStepsPartialExec
methods.description: Inserts notes and statuses for test steps execution partial results, cleaning old data to prevent duplicates, and handling status validation.

methods.name: isLinkedTCVersion
methods.description: Checks if a specific test case version is linked to a given test plan.

methods.name: getStepsPartialExec
methods.description: Retrieves partial execution information for specified test steps within a given context.

methods.name: deleteStepsPartialExec
methods.description: Deletes partial execution data for specified test steps within a given context.

methods.name: getLatestExecIDInContext
methods.description: Retrieves the latest execution ID for a test case version within a specified context.

methods.name: getFreePlatforms
methods.description: Fetches platforms that are available for associating with a test case, excluding those already linked.

methods.name: deletePlatformsByLink
methods.description: Deletes platform links for a test case based on link IDs, performing cleanup and optional audit logging.

methods.name: deletePlatforms
methods.description: Removes platform associations for a test case version, with optional audit and platform-specific filtering.

methods.name: getPlatformsMap
methods.description: Returns a map of platforms linked to a specific test case and version, with options for detailed output.

methods.name: getPlatformsAsXMLString
methods.description: Exports platform data as an XML string for a given test case and version.

methods.name: addPlatforms
methods.description: Associates a set of platforms with a test case, avoiding duplicates, and optionally auditing the action.

methods.name: getPlatforms
methods.description: Retrieves platforms linked to a test case and version, with filtering and output customization options.

methods.name: getDeleteTCVPlatformRelativeURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL for removing a platform link from a test case, optionally including GUI parameters.

methods.name: copyPlatformsTo
methods.description: Copies platform associations from a source test case to a destination, optionally deleting existing links in the destination.

methods.name: getLTCVInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the latest test case version, including parent hierarchy, version info, status, and external IDs.

methods.name: getTestProjectKeywords
methods.description: Fetches the keywords associated with a specific test project ID.
